name: Awe Widget Set
description: The full Awe suite: 24 Material 3 desktop widgets for your wallpaper - clocks, calendar, notes, habits, media, weather, thermals and more - ported to run as Ryoku plugins. Install the set, then toggle each one from the desktop's Add widget menu.

items.name: awe-battery
items.summary: Battery charge level and charging state with a vector icon badge and progress bar, read from /sys.

items.name: awe-calc
items.summary: Material-style desktop calculator with a safe expression evaluator.

items.name: awe-calendar
items.summary: Compact monthly calendar that highlights today's date.

items.name: awe-clipboard
items.summary: A rolling clipboard history read from wl-paste; click an entry to copy it back with wl-copy.

items.name: awe-clock
items.summary: Analog and digital desktop clock with cookie, Nothing-OS, stacked and digital faces.

items.name: awe-crypto
items.summary: Live BTC / ETH / SOL prices with 24h change and a sparkline, polled from the CoinGecko API.

items.name: awe-git-dashboard
items.summary: Shows the branch, dirty-file count, and last commit of the git repository in your home directory.

items.name: awe-habits
items.summary: Weekly habit tracker with streak counts and a seven-day matrix, saved locally.

items.name: awe-media
items.summary: Now-playing card driven by playerctl (MPRIS): album art, scrubbable progress and transport controls.

items.name: awe-network
items.summary: Live Wi-Fi status, local IP, and up/down throughput with an activity sparkline.

items.name: awe-notes
items.summary: Inline-editable sticky notes with colour tags, saved locally between sessions.

items.name: awe-ping
items.summary: Live latency monitor with a jitter sparkline, pinging Cloudflare and Google DNS.

items.name: awe-poster
items.summary: A decorative image frame that masks a picture or GIF into a Material organic shape.

items.name: awe-quote
items.summary: A rotating card of programming and design quotes; click refresh to cycle to the next one.

items.name: awe-resource-wheel
items.summary: Concentric CPU, RAM, disk and temperature gauge with a live legend, polled from /proc and the filesystem.

items.name: awe-storage-map
items.summary: Root filesystem usage with a segmented bar and a used and free breakdown, read from df.

items.name: awe-system-info
items.summary: CPU, RAM and disk usage in three frosted tiles; double-click to switch between horizontal and vertical layouts.

items.name: awe-thermal
items.summary: CPU package temperature with per-core bars and a live status tag, from the kernel thermal zone and lm_sensors.

items.name: awe-timer
items.summary: Focus / break / stopwatch timer with a circular progress ring and adjustable custom durations.

items.name: awe-todo
items.summary: Desktop task list with a progress bar and per-task completion, saved locally.

items.name: awe-visualizer
items.summary: Animated audio spectrum in bar, wave and radial modes that reacts to playerctl playback state.

items.name: awe-volume-brightness
items.summary: Volume and screen-brightness sliders with mute, driven by wpctl and brightnessctl.

items.name: awe-weather
items.summary: Local conditions, temperature, wind and humidity, refreshed from wttr.in on a timer and on click.

items.name: awe-clock-world
items.summary: Multiple time zones in four switchable layouts; double-click to cycle the layout.
